title: Chunk
$comment: NOT EXPRESSIBLE HERE, HELD BY TEST: `nx` is required on every chunk of index i < n-1 and forbidden on the chunk of index n-1 (§7.4). JSON Schema cannot compare `i` against `n`, so T-P1-11 and T-P9-3 are the court. Also held by test: the whole HCS-10 `message` operation carrying this Chunk as a JSON string in `data` is at most CHUNK_WIRE_MAX = 1000 bytes and carries no chunkInfo (§7.4, T-P9-7). AUTHORED object (§5.1): produced by an actor and validated against this schema. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it.

n.description: chunkCount. A chunk whose `n` differs from chunk 0’s is a conflicting chunk and is not of this envelope (§8.5).

nx.description: Digest of chunk i+1’s slice; absent on the last chunk (§7.4).

hdr.description: Chunk 0 only. The header, which rebuilds to `id` through the AAD (§5.6, §7.2).

l.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
l.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

pr.description: Resolution profile identifier (§9). A release claiming the `document` extension (§16.5) widens this enum.

rp.description: resolutionProof {hash, uri} in the chunk’s short keys.

u.description: A structured locator naming one HCS message (§5.2). Not an HRL: the HCS-1 HRL grammar names files, not messages.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

h.description: ciphertextDigest, over the whole ciphertext. Appears inside `hdr` and nowhere else (T-P9-3).

hdr.$comment: `nx` is forbidden inside `hdr` and `h` appears only here (T-P9-3).

allOf.$comment: Chunk 0 carries the header; no other chunk does (§5.6).
